title.zh: 所得税（经济发展与技术开发贷款利息及其他付款豁免）公告 2022
title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments on Economic and Technological Development Loans) Notification 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments on Economic and Technological Development Loans) Notification 2022 and is deemed to have come into operation on 8 April 2012.

2.—(1) The interest of JPY214,069,590 payable by United Sky Shipping Pte. Ltd. to Galva Kogyo Co., Ltd from 8 April 2012 to 8 February 2025 (both dates inclusive), in respect of a loan granted under a loan agreement dated 10 February 2010 to finance the acquisition of a Singapore‑flagged vessel “Chemical Mariner” is exempt from tax.
(2) The exemption under sub‑paragraph (1) is subject to the terms and conditions specified in the letter of approval dated 3 February 2022 issued by the Ministry of Finance and addressed to United Sky Shipping Pte. Ltd.
